case.source_note: Sale is fully furnished, one bay, header 1+1 versus body 1BR. Historical product record calls 680-sf stock studios. Base rent is an asking-informed whole-unit assumption, not a signed lease.
case.mechanism: A lower entry quantum may monetise Ara accessibility for small households without family-sized acquisition cost.
case.buyer: Primary resale underwriting is investor-led. Single/couple owner adoption is possible but unmeasured. Pacific Place 864-sf two-bedroom and Eve 1065-sf two-bedroom compete on different space/price tradeoffs.
case.project: Historic studio-heavy mix increases correlated small-unit competition; it does not establish current investor ownership or vacancy. No MC records inspected.
case.comp: Brickz reports 18 mixed transactions in May 2025-April 2026; a visible 689-sf/3-room RM364k row cannot be treated as an exact 680-sf studio match.
case.reversal: At assumed costs the low-rent case fails monthly coverage; even base coverage can coexist with negative annual carry. A small charge or net-rent difference can reverse the lead.
case.next: Resolve approved room/area and bay rights; obtain ordinary leases near RM2k and charges; test a matched compact transfer and current competing inventory. Reopen priority only if this changes the financial or exit burden.
